heroWidget.title: THE FORGOTTEN DRIFT
heroWidget.description: An anomalous narrative journey through forgotten carriage routes and temporal shadows.

characters.name: KAIEN
characters.description: Grounded, observant, and calculated. Operating in the urban sectors of the CODEV2E story universe, Kaien navigates anomalous narrative fractures with calm tactical discipline.

characters.name: LILITH
characters.quote: BREAK THROUGH FIRST, ASK QUESTIONS LATER
characters.description: Relentless, explosive, and instinct-driven in combat. Marked by her signature magenta hair streak and combat duelist glove, Lilith spearheads frontline incursions into unstable zones.

characters.name: REN
characters.description: The strategic core of the squad. Specializes in decrypting synthetic signal architectures, narrative code, and mapping anomaly threats before engagement.

characters.name: AERIS
characters.description: A high-reflex dimensional pilot capable of steering crew vessels through volatile drift channels connecting the core sectors of the CODEV2E universe.

characters.name: ZERO-X
characters.description: A mysterious heavy combatant engineered during the early foundation era. His true allegiances and memories remain encrypted behind high-grade security protocols.

projects.title: PROJECT ALPHA: DISRUPTION
projects.description: The flagship original anime production following Kaien and Lilith as they uncover the truth behind the CODEV2E world anomalies.

projects.title: SECTOR VOID CHRONICLES
projects.description: An exploratory visual series detailing the origins of the anomaly duelist factions and narrative drift engines.
